chunks: It has been narrated that two boys approached Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام holding two tablets in their hands, and they said: “O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, judge between us.”

Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: “Indeed, injustice in this is like injustice in legal rulings. Convey to your teacher on my behalf that if he strikes you more than three times, that will be retribution on the Day of Judgment.”
ai.seo_question: What did Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام say about a teacher striking children more than three times?
ai.summary: This hadith shows that fairness in even small matters, such as judging between children, is treated with the same seriousness as fairness in formal rulings. It also sets a moral and legal limit on a teacher’s discipline, warning that excess beating becomes a matter of accountability on the Day of Judgment.
